title: AI-Based Signal Detection System for Residential TV Dish Alignment
summary: MUST proposes training an AI model on dish-misalignment patterns to improve realignment. Its current design uses stored angles and feedback controls; AI-related gains remain unmeasured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: MUST describes a satellite-dish prototype using stored service-provider angles, motor controls, and signal feedback. It also proposes training an AI model on misalignment patterns to speed up realignment. Deployment of the model and its effect on reliability, adjustment time, and maintenance effort remain unverified. Multi-provider operation and hardware savings concern the wider design.
purpose: Use a trained misalignment model to improve automatic satellite-dish realignment.
system: Proposed AI misalignment model for residential satellite dishes
developer: Mbeya University of Science and Technology (MUST)

ratings.reason: The proposed model is intended to speed up dish realignment and reduce household inconvenience. Benefits from an implemented model are unreported.
Faster AI-assisted realignment is intended to reduce servicing effort. Savings from the proposed learned model are not established.

ai_role.statement: A learned misalignment model is proposed as future work. The currently specified stored-angle lookup, motor movement and feedback controls do not by themselves establish AI use.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 8: AI-Based Signal Detection System for Residential TV Dish Alignment

produced_by: Proposed training of an AI model on dish-misalignment patterns
must_hold: Representative labeled misalignment and signal-quality data
Satellite signal measurements and alignment-control hardware
Prototype testing in a university or residential setting

headline: Proposed AI model for satellite-dish realignment
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
